evaluation.cohorts: Frozen CPUv2 files; source-TRAIN-derived DEV, not official TEST
evaluation.primary_target: sum log probability of all16 original native continuation tokens; no synthetic EOS
evaluation.arithmetic_secondary: Complete original numeral plus closing boundary, numeric-only span, and K1 separated; original numeral lies entirely inside16 on every row.
evaluation.models: All6 terminal checkpoints and unchanged B0; separate data-order results; B0 evaluated once
evaluation.held_writer_input: Question-only projection: native prefix IDs and identity only; no future, teacher, numeric answer or evaluation outcome.

training_recipe_gate.interpretation: New supervised recipe improves direct prediction over both complete trained recipes; does not alone establish improvement over B0.

absolute_base_gate.interpretation: Separately tests a new best starting-model prediction path.

retention_target.primary: Ordinary mean of per-document mean NLL over all527 real transitions
secondary: same ordinary delta versus both trained controls
retention_target.interpretation: Declared small-retention-cost target for this predictive study. A miss remains a measured tradeoff; it does not erase other positive capability evidence or justify terminating a healthy run.

overall_CPT_criterion: Training-recipe and absolute-base gates pass in both orders, and retention target met. Otherwise identify exactly which claim passed or failed.

inference_gate.status: Secondary, separately declared; not a rescue for a failed direct-prediction primary
inference_gate.notes: Greedy prefix-only work, cap128 native actions including Answer/EOS; all failed/capped/unsupported generations retained. Report format control and B0 alongside.

content_controls: intact unrelated generated note from a fixed hash donor permutation with no fixed points

numerical_accuracy.endpoint: Frozen initial-scalar-v2 complete value under raw/empty/own paths
numerical_accuracy.comparison: same underlying prefixes/models; paired proportions with unsupported/error/cap counts
numerical_accuracy.inference_budget: actual actions and latency; scalar generation contract frozen using TRAIN only
numerical_accuracy.notes: Gold-independent parser/stop rule, original answers retained. Canonical likelihood and complete-value accuracy never substituted.

failure_policy: No missing rows silently dropped; execution failures reported and no scientific pass until required endpoints are complete. Healthy runs are not stopped based on early loss or outcome.
statistical_limits: Conditional on fixed checkpoints; two data-order seeds do not measure full training/model uncertainty.
Four required primary comparisons form a conjunctive claim; report each unadjusted paired95 interval, do not select favorable orders or contrasts.
Normal power calculations are planning assumptions, not bootstrap guarantees.
